card.name: Letter or number in list labels
card.fires_on: A single letter or digit that labels a sub-item, footnote or cross-reference, such as the 'd' in '1a and 1d' or a footnote letter after a table entry. It fires just before the next part of the label or the closing bracket.

modes.label: Footnote letters in tables
modes.description: A lone letter after a table row name or value marks a footnote.

modes.label: Cross-reference numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a parenthetical reference to a numbered section or sub-item.
